text:
lina.design: Small follow-up from the onboarding review: I prototyped a condensed checklist card that appears beneath the hero for first-time accounts. Each checklist item is an inline action (e.g., 'Create API key', 'Try sample project'). Want eyes on copy, CTA order, and a11y behavior.

chris.product: Checklist is great for lowering time-to-first-success. Question: do we treat samples as part of the checklist or a separate 'Explore' action? I think items that are required for core onboarding (API key) should be first, samples optional.

ben.eng: Implementation thoughts: checklist items will map to backend tasks and have a small state machine: not-started / in-progress / done. We can call a single batched endpoint for status to avoid many round-trips. For anonymous users, checklist is local-only.

zara.a11y: Accessibility: 
- Each checklist item should be a focusable list item with `aria-checked` or `role=button` depending on whether it's toggleable or an action.
- Provide a concise accessible summary at top like "Onboarding checklist, 1 of 4 complete" that updates dynamically.
- Ensure color is not sole indicator of completion. Add an icon + text.

lina.design: Copy candidates: 
- Item label: 'Create API key' (CTA: 'Create')
- Item label: 'Run a sample project' (CTA: 'Launch sample')
- Item label: 'Invite teammate' (CTA: 'Invite')
- Item label: 'View observability' (CTA: 'Open dashboard')

chris.product: For the sample item, microcopy suggestion: 'Run a working demo to see end-to-end flow'. CTA 'Launch sample' better than 'Try' per a11y guidelines. Also, move API key creation to the top by default.

ben.eng: We'll add events: `onboard.checklist_impression`, `onboard.checklist_action_clicked`, `onboard.checklist_item_completed`. We can rehydrate item state from existing task events if present.

zara.a11y: Two more nits: 
- When an item is completed, announce via `aria-live` "Item X completed".
- Ensure the 'Create API key' flow surfaces copy that confirms scopes and safe handling; users relying on screen readers need that context.

lina.design: I'll iterate the visual so completed items show an icon + 'Completed' label. Also will include a small help link next to API key item: 'How keys work' that opens a dialog.

chris.product: Let's gate the checklist to new orgs only for the first 14 days, then collapse into a small affordance in the left rail. A/B test the duration.

ben.eng: Sounds good. Estimated effort: 2 frontend days + 1 backend day for batched status and events.

ci-bot: Preview deploy created: https://staging.redwood.ai/build/1743 — smoke tests passed.

lina.design: Thanks all, I'll push the refined copy and acceptance criteria into the ticket. :sparkles:
